info.name: AI Lead Qualification Agent
info.description:
Automated lead qualification system using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini.

Set the {{base_url}} variable to http://localhost:8000 before running.

request.description:
Submit a new inbound lead. Triggers the full qualification workflow:
1. Validate payload
2. Persist to SQLite
3. Qualify via OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
4. Route via CRM logic
5. Log notification
